title: order.confirmed.v1 topic renamed to order.confirmed.v2
query: What breaks across repositories if the Kafka topic order.confirmed.v1 is renamed to order.confirmed.v2?

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: produces order.confirmed.v1; OrderSagaIntegrationTest awaits the topic by name

affected_repositories.name: shipment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: OrderConfirmedListener subscribes with @KafkaListener topics order.confirmed.v1; no shipment is created after the rename

affected_repositories.name: basket-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: OrderConfirmedListener subscribes with @KafkaListener topics order.confirmed.v1; baskets never complete after the rename

affected_repositories.name: commerce-platform
affected_repositories.evidence_note: kafka/topic-definitions.yaml declares order.confirmed.v1; platform contract coverage references it

notes: Topic rename with no dual-publish window. Both consumers subscribe by literal topic string, so a producer-side rename silently orphans them. commerce-platform is test_only: it owns topic definitions, not runtime behavior.
